text: So sorry to message this late, I really don't want to waste anyone's time. I'm looking after my niece Amara, she's 9, and she's been hot all evening, 39.2 on the thermometer just now. I keep checking her skin because something looked off on her arms but honestly with her skin being dark it's so hard to tell what I'm looking at. So I looked at the lighter bits instead. Her palms have little dark specks on them, like someone flicked a pen at her, and when I pulled her bottom eyelid down there are tiny red dots in there too. I pressed a glass on her hand like I remember from somewhere and the specks were still there through the glass, they didn't go anywhere. Her mum's on a night shift and I don't want to panic her for nothing. Sorry again, I just didn't know who else to ask
